item.title: Kolkata Rocked by Strong Tremors After 5.5 Quake in Bangladesh
item.description: Kolkata experienced strong tremors on February 27, 2026, after a 5.4 earthquake struck Nayabazar, Bangladesh. Buildings evacuated, no immediate casualties reported
